precedence: This override is higher authority for Year 6 SAT lesson access/release semantics, SAT CSV/display-code resolution, and Maths equivalent-view navigation presentation for Year 4/L1, Year 5/L2 and Year 6/L3. All non-conflicting Portal V2 authority remains binding.

ownerRequirement.rule: Year 6 SAT lessons must not inherit broad MATHS_Y6_FULL / Year 6 full-view core access. They are released lesson-by-lesson through the normal Lesson Release Import workflow.
releaseStates: LOCKED until a canonical release exists
PRELESSON_ONLY when the normal online PreLesson rule applies
FULL when the normal completed/continuing lesson release grants core access
ownerRequirement.ordinaryYear6Boundary: Normal Year 6 lessons retain existing full-library and direct-release semantics.
ownerRequirement.displayPreservation: Admin tables, CSV-facing state and parent-facing lesson labels retain Y6SMn. Internal resolver compatibility may translate Y6SMn to legacy Y6MSn and then canonical Y6M(50+n), but must not expose the legacy alias to users.

navigationPresentation.globalEquivalentRule: A Maths student must never be shown both members of an equivalent curriculum pair: Year 4/L1, Year 5/L2, or Year 6/L3. If the L-level exists, the L-level is the teaching-curriculum presentation.
navigationPresentation.l3Student: Show L3 and SATS, never Year 6 and L3. The SATS card exposes the Year 6 SAT subset without widening entitlement.
navigationPresentation.ordinaryYear6Student: Show Lessons and SATS. Lessons contains the normal Year 6 teaching curriculum; SATS contains the SAT lesson subset.
navigationPresentation.year4Level1: If Year 4 and L1 are both present for the same Maths curriculum, present L1 only.
navigationPresentation.year5Level2: If Year 5 and L2 are both present for the same Maths curriculum, present L2 only.
navigationPresentation.accessBoundary: Equivalent-card collapsing and the Lessons/SATS split are presentation/navigation transformations only. They must not broaden lesson entitlements, change batch membership, or convert SAT direct-release access into full Year 6 access.

implementation.mapping: Y6SM1..Y6SM19 -> internal compatibility Y6MS1..Y6MS19 -> canonical Y6M51..Y6M69
implementation.finalCompositionRule: index-admin-tools.js delegates ordinary requests to index-maths-equivalent-navigation-final.js; that wrapper delegates to the complete current index-phase24-trial-vr.js chain and normalises the final /api/v1/student/home response only after all lower student layers have completed.

syntheticPresentationViews.maths-year6-lessons: delegates authorization to canonical maths-year6 and filters out Y6 SAT lessons
syntheticPresentationViews.maths-sats: delegates authorization to canonical maths-year6 and filters to Y6 SAT lessons

implementation.frontendRule: The DOM compatibility layer must preserve real server-supplied L3+SATS or Lessons+SATS cards and must not manufacture a duplicate SATS card when the server already supplied one.
implementation.productionPreservationVerification: PASS: final navigation syntax/composition, current shared Worker preflight, forward-only deploy, live bindings, parent-email live routing, quiz bridge, Replace Resource, lesson-release import, Trial runtime, Y6SM alias, maths-year6-lessons, maths-sats and maths-equivalent-navigation-final-v1 markers all verified by workflow.

incident20260927FinalComposition.ownerEvidenceBeforeRepair: After the earlier server-navigation deployment and frontend Pages deployment had both reported PASS, Devansh's live Maths screen still showed Year 6 (1 open, 66 locked) and L3 (0 open, 43 locked).
incident20260927FinalComposition.meaning: The earlier completion claim was invalid. Presence of change15 markers in the deployed bundle and passing pure-function tests did not prove that the final response returned through the complete shared-Worker composition satisfied the navigation invariant.
incident20260927FinalComposition.rootCause: Equivalent-view normalisation existed in a lower student phase. The deployment verification proved that code was bundled but did not prove the final /api/v1/student/home response at the Admin-tools boundary was normalised. The owner browser readback proved an unnormalised Year 6 + L3 response still escaped the complete production chain.
incident20260927FinalComposition.forwardOnlyRepair: Add an outer final navigation wrapper immediately beneath index-admin-tools.js and above the complete phase24 student chain. It re-applies equivalent-view normalisation to the final home response and handles synthetic Lessons/SATS lists at that final boundary. No rollback or older Worker deployment was used.
incident20260927FinalComposition.verificationImprovement: Shared-worker preservation CI now asserts the exact index-admin-tools -> final Maths wrapper -> phase24 composition, and production deployment greps for the runtime-used maths-equivalent-navigation-final-v1 marker in the live Worker bundle.
incident20260927FinalComposition.remainingGate: Owner browser retest of Devansh and a representative ordinary Year 6 student; representative L3/Year aliases such as Kiaan should also be checked before closure.

verificationMatrix: Y6SMn remains the visible lesson code in Admin/CSV/email-facing surfaces.
Legacy Y6MSn remains accepted for compatibility only.
MATHS_Y6_FULL alone does not open Y6M51..Y6M69.
A direct canonical SAT entitlement opens only the released SAT lesson FULL.
A normal SAT PreLesson entitlement opens only that SAT lesson PRELESSON_ONLY.
Year 4 plus L1 collapses to L1 for the teaching-curriculum presentation.
Year 5 plus L2 collapses to L2 for the teaching-curriculum presentation.
Year 6 plus L3 collapses to L3 plus SATS; Year 6 is not retained as a second teaching card.
An ordinary Year 6 student is presented with Lessons plus SATS.
SATS navigation filters to Y6M51..Y6M69/Y6SM1..Y6SM19 without widening access.
Synthetic Lessons/SATS view IDs map back to canonical maths-year6 before lower authorization/resource handling.
Final /api/v1/student/home normalisation occurs above the complete phase24 student chain and below Admin Tools.
Shared production Worker retains quiz bridge, Admin tools, Trial runtime, resource replacement, lesson release import, protected-answer behaviour and parent email capabilities.
preservationInvariants: Production recovery is forward-only; do not revert, roll back, restore an older Worker or deploy an older entrypoint.
Do not alter normal Year 6 lesson access.
Do not renumber canonical Y6 SAT lesson IDs.
Do not expose Y6MSn as the owner-facing code; Y6SMn is authoritative for CSV/display use.
Do not use Year 4, Year 5 or Year 6 duplicate cards when their L1, L2 or L3 equivalent is already present.
Do not alter Trial session semantics, normal student sessions, protected Answer Packs, online 11+ English PreLesson VR, resource replacement, parent-email routing or quiz bridge behaviour.

A marker being present in the Worker bundle is not sufficient browser verification; do not declare this repair closed until owner browser evidence confirms representative live students after the final-boundary deployment.
